# Ivoclar

> Ivoclar is a leading dental materials and CAD/CAM technology provider offering comprehensive workflows, software systems, and product documentation for dentists and laboratory technicians.

Ivoclar specializes in dental prosthetics, restorative materials, and digital workflow solutions including CAD/CAM systems (Programat, IvoBase, PrograMill), 3D printing technologies, and electronic instructions for use (EIFU) documentation. The site serves healthcare professionals with product information, software updates, regulatory compliance documentation, and customer support resources.

## Key Topics

- CAD/CAM systems
- 3D printing
- Dental prosthetics
- Programat
- PrograMill
- IvoBase
- Electronic instructions for use (EIFU)
- Product documentation
- Regulatory compliance
- Software updates
- Dental workflows
- Amann Girrbach partnerships
- Dentsply Sirona partnerships
- Planmeca partnerships
- Restorative materials

## Dental Workflows & Solutions

- [Dental Workflows for Dentists & Lab Technicians](https://www.ivoclar.com/en_us/workflows/workflow-overview): Overview of dental workflows for CAD/CAM, 3D printing, and restorations
- [Partnership Agreements | Dental CAD/CAM Units](https://www.ivoclar.com/en_us/local/partnership-agreements): CAD/CAM partnerships with Amann Girrbach, Dentsply Sirona, Planmeca
